# Ali Sawly

Ali Sawly (علي صولي) is a Lebanese filmmaker and director.

## Official Website
[https://alisawly.com/](https://alisawly.com/)

## About
Ali Sawly (علي صولي) is a Lebanese filmmaker and director. This website is his official professional portfolio.

## Film
بلدةٌ طيبة (Baladet Tayba) is a graduation documentary film directed by Ali Sawly.
[https://alisawly.com/baldatayba](https://alisawly.com/baldatayba)
